methodology:
Eagle High Plantations operates ~119K hectares (~294K acres) across Kalimantan (largest cluster), Sumatra, and Sulawesi. 3-row breakdown:
- Kalimantan core (175K acres): largest cluster, mix of mature and immature
- Sumatra (65K acres): mature plantation
- Sulawesi + concession-stage (54K acres): smaller / unplanted

BWPT carries significant debt (financial distress in recent years has led to per-acre value compression). FMVs marked at ~10-15% discount to healthier-balance-sheet peers to reflect distressed-operator selling pressure.
